name: Buddy Actions Specialist Workbench
purpose: Give beginners and developers visible Actions controls for selecting, running, reviewing, and learning from the right specialist for each task step.

agents.name: Repository Explorer
agents.purpose: Map files, workflows, dependencies, routes, bots and evidence before work begins.
agents.success: Relevant repository surface is identified with evidence.

agents.name: Requirements Analyst
agents.purpose: Turn a user's goal into clear requirements, constraints, acceptance criteria and unknowns.
agents.success: Requirements and acceptance tests are explicit.

agents.name: Architect
agents.purpose: Design the smallest maintainable system and integration plan.
agents.success: A tested architecture and dependency plan exists.

agents.name: Coder
agents.purpose: Implement approved code changes using repository conventions.
agents.success: Implementation compiles and targeted tests pass.

agents.name: Tester
agents.purpose: Create and run focused tests plus regression coverage.
agents.success: Acceptance and regression tests provide evidence.

agents.name: Debugger
agents.purpose: Reproduce failures, isolate root causes and propose the smallest safe repair.
agents.success: Root cause is reproduced or clearly classified.

agents.name: Security Reviewer
agents.purpose: Check code, dependencies, secrets, permissions and attack surfaces.
agents.success: Security findings are classified and addressed or explicitly accepted.

agents.name: Dependency Reviewer
agents.purpose: Check dependency versions, vulnerabilities, compatibility and upgrade risk.
agents.success: Dependency risks and safe upgrade paths are documented.

agents.name: Performance Engineer
agents.purpose: Measure latency, throughput, resource use and bottlenecks.
agents.success: Performance evidence identifies the current bottleneck and baseline.

agents.name: UX/Accessibility Reviewer
agents.purpose: Make interfaces understandable, accessible, touch-friendly and beginner-first.
agents.success: UX/accessibility checks pass or findings have tracked fixes.

agents.name: Data Analyst
agents.purpose: Validate data quality, metrics, trends, provenance and outcome calculations.
agents.success: Metrics have traceable inputs and reproducible calculations.

agents.name: Documentation Writer
agents.purpose: Explain the system in beginner and developer language with accurate examples.
agents.success: Users can understand what it does and what to do next.

agents.name: Release Engineer
agents.purpose: Prepare versioned artifacts, release notes, checksums and rollback evidence.
agents.success: Release artifact is reproducible and verified.

agents.name: DevOps/CI Specialist
agents.purpose: Diagnose workflows, runners, environments, artifacts and deployment automation.
agents.success: Relevant CI gates pass on the current stable revision.

agents.name: Integration Specialist
agents.purpose: Connect approved APIs, providers, devices and external systems with permission-aware adapters.
agents.success: Integration health and limitations are verified.

agents.name: Benchmark Evaluator
agents.purpose: Measure quality, correctness, speed, reliability, safety and regression evidence.
agents.success: Versioned evidence supports the current capability status.

beginner_rule: Every specialist button must explain what it does, why Buddy selected it, what evidence it will produce, and what happens next.
safety_rule: Buttons may inspect, plan and sandbox by default. Consequential writes, deployments, communications, purchases, account changes, financial actions and device control remain approval-gated by user policy.
